description: Fail-closed regression gate for provider-neutral GIMP/creative-desktop generative interoperability projected through the existing FA3 MMG Context IR and existing generative/runtime/security/resource authorities.

checks.name: Provider portfolio exists
checks.expected: FA3-PROVIDER-GIMP-COMFYUI-INTEROP-001 is optional, replaceable and non-authoritative

checks.name: Existing MMG Context IR is reused
checks.expected: FA3-MMG-CONTEXT-IR-001 remains the single canonical generation-context IR authority

checks.name: Authority boundaries remain intact
checks.expected: No plugin or adapter becomes orchestration, workflow, model registry/router, host resource, security/license or evidence authority

checks.name: Editor semantics are preserved
checks.expected: document, canvas, layer ordering, visibility, selection, mask, alpha and color/profile semantics are represented distinctly

checks.name: Provider workflow stays downstream
checks.expected: Provider-native prompt/workflow syntax is projection-only, loss is reported and hard-constraint loss fails closed

checks.name: Endpoint and hardware are dynamic
checks.expected: No canonical hard-coded ComfyUI host/port, GPU model, device count or device identity

checks.name: Supply-chain admission is mandatory
checks.expected: Plugin, dependency, workflow, custom-node and model-artifact admission/inventory/hash controls apply

checks.name: License boundary is enforced
checks.expected: GPL reference code is pattern-only for permissive FA3 code intake unless an explicit license-policy change authorizes otherwise

checks.name: Document mutations are nondestructive
checks.expected: Default result placement is new layer/new document and failures or partial results do not mutate the source document

checks.name: Live transport remains optional
checks.expected: Live WebSocket/custom-node transport is optional, local-first and non-authoritative; cloud is not required

checks.name: Upstream references are immutable
checks.expected: Every evaluated upstream reference records repository, 40-character revision, observed date and license

checks.name: Runtime evidence is not overclaimed
checks.expected: No current-host production claim is made without fresh executable runtime evidence

pass_condition: All GDG-01 through GDG-15 checks pass and no P0 invariant in canonical/gimp-comfyui-interop-enforcement.json is violated.
promotion_rule: Reference/design CI PASS proves canonical conformance only; current-host GIMP/ComfyUI runtime promotion requires separate fresh production runtime evidence.
